summary: Twenty One Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Paul Lalljie to its Board of Directors and Audit Committee effective June 5, 2026, filling a vacancy to regain NYSE compliance. The filing includes his compensation: a $150,000 annual cash retainer and $150,000 annual Class A stock award. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine director appointment and governance update. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 is also routine. No deal terms exist.
